metadata.title: Assemble Levels, Construct Ground, and Follow Targets

abstract.text: Load your level and catalogs, construct horizontal ground, and follow a character
horizontally, vertically, or in all 2D directions with reusable API helpers.

The default character factory produces the SDK’s enemy node class. Use

world root, and ground result. These callbacks are synchronous and may throw. Assembly

Use

tile. A zero height uses the device tile height or source texture height.
The device tile size overrides both source dimensions. An omitted size or
a size with either dimension equal to zero uses both source dimensions.
LevelEditor requires both dimensions of a new override to be at least one.
The builder

also extends to the right when a whole tile exceeds the opening. The material
draws beneath overlapping ground. Use

collision. Add a game-specific sensor if contact should trigger swimming or damage.

content.text: Follow a target horizontally, vertically, or in all 2D directions

inlineContent.text: supports independent horizontal and vertical axis controls.
Horizontal following is enabled by default, and vertical following is disabled.
Follow mode
Horizontal (default)
Vertical
All 2D directions
Neither axis
A disabled axis retains the camera’s existing position. Enabling both axes follows
any combination of horizontal, vertical, and diagonal target movement; it does not
rotate the camera or automatically change zoom.
Retain the helper as a scene property and update it after physics. This example
follows the target on both axes:
For vertical-only following, set
and
. For horizontal-only following, use the defaults.
Smoothing and look-ahead work on each enabled axis. Smoothing is an exponential
response per second; zero snaps immediately. Set
for a horizontal
offset and
for a vertical offset. These offsets are fixed in
camera-parent coordinates; they do not automatically reverse with target movement.
Optional
constrain each enabled axis and use camera-parent coordinates.
A world smaller than the viewport centers on that axis. Supply bounds covering the
full playable height for vertical or all-direction following. Terrain-only bounds
that are no taller than the viewport prevent vertical travel even when
is enabled. Set
for unrestricted following. Update
when the view, scale mode, or camera zoom changes;
it must describe the visible world dimensions, rather than screen pixels. Keep the
camera unrotated. The helper handles target coordinate conversion, weak references,
invalid frame deltas, and targets removed from the scene. Reset your frame timer after
pausing to avoid a large resume delta.
